Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
New "FPS" section under Client. "Limit FPS" caps the frame rate to any value from 30 to 360 (default 60), not just the game's 30 or 60; set the game's own limit to none for it to work. "Limit FPS when unfocused" has its own cap from 1 to 60 for while the game is alt-tabbed. The FPS entry on the server info bar turns green while the limit is holding, and "Live FPS" updates the number four times a second instead of once, without changing the chart. The high FPS physics fix now lives in this section too.

The old "Server info" settings under Indicators are split up so each sits with what it belongs to. "Show ping in server bar" is now at the top of Client, "Show nearby player count in server bar" is under Social > Nearby players, and "Show current song in server bar" is under Client > Media controls.
